maps.title: Forest Road Ambush
maps.description: muddy forest road winding through dense pine woods, a fallen log blocking the road, thick undergrowth and boulders for cover on both sides

maps.title: Stone Dungeon Corridor
maps.description: stone dungeon with flagstone floors, 10ft corridors connecting several square rooms, iron-bound doors, a collapsed pillar and scattered bones

maps.title: Underground Cavern
maps.description: vast underground cavern with an underground lake, glowing mushrooms, stalagmites and a narrow rock ledge path along the water

maps.title: Volcano Boss Arena
maps.description: volcanic caldera boss arena of cracked black basalt islands surrounded by rivers of glowing lava, a ruined obsidian altar at the centre

maps.title: Docks at Night
maps.description: harbour docks at night, wooden piers over dark water, moored rowing boats, stacked crates and barrels, lanterns on posts

maps.title: Flooded Goblin Cavern
maps.description: flooded goblin cavern with a rickety wooden bridge over a fast underground river, crude goblin campfire and bedrolls

maps.title: Ruined Temple Courtyard
maps.description: ruined desert temple courtyard with broken sandstone columns, a dry fountain, drifting sand and a sealed tomb entrance

maps.title: Frozen Mountain Pass
maps.description: snowy mountain pass with a frozen stream, icy boulders, snow-laden pines and an abandoned wooden watch post

maps.title: Crypt of the Forgotten
maps.description: ancient crypt with rows of stone sarcophagi, narrow burial niches, cobwebbed 10ft corridors and a candlelit central ossuary
